why: The adapter executes the pinned Loreley checkout's own code, which needs that checkout's dependencies (pydantic, SQLAlchemy, psycopg, numpy). Those are installed into a copy of the pinned checkout at checkout/.venv; a harness that discovers '/usr/bin/python3 -m a0_adapter' cannot import 'loreley'.

Every path here is relative to this manifest's own directory, which is the conformance runner's launch cwd (a0/conformance/conformance.py:3773-3776 launches with cwd = the adapter directory). An absolute host root here would make a copy of the tree launch and write into the original.

bin/a0-loreley resolves its own location (BASH_SOURCE) and pins the interpreter as $HERE/../checkout/.venv/bin/python, so it works from any cwd and without PYTHONPATH; the interpreter field above is the same relative path, kept for readers.
A0_LORELEY_PYTHON overrides the interpreter; A0_LORELEY_REEXECUTED=1 suppresses the adapter's own re-exec fallback inside cli.main.
